payout_quote: Adventure sends you a $100 Amazon or VISA gift card. ... Your $100 referral reward will be paid 30-days after your friend's membership open date.
steps: Enter your email on adventurecu.org/refer-a-friend to generate your unique referral link.
Share the link; your friend joins Adventure CU as a new member using it.
Friend keeps the membership open and in good standing for at least 30 days — you get the $100 gift card.
catches: Reward is a $100 Amazon or VISA digital gift card, not cash deposited to an account.
Friend must keep the membership open and in good standing for at least 30 days — close early and the $100 is forfeited.
Advocate must be an eligible member in good standing with a valid email on file; both parties 16+.
No referral-count cap stated on the page; program terms can change.
biggest_catch: Payout is a $100 Amazon/VISA gift card (not cash) and only lands after your friend keeps the account open and in good standing for 30 days.
eligibility: Current Adventure CU member in good standing (Michigan footprint: live, work, worship, or attend school in MI); friend 16+, membership-eligible.
timing: Generate and share a link in ~5 minutes; $100 gift card emailed ~30 days after the friend's membership open date.
